_comment: RUN-001 permit revocation list. This file must EXIST for any permit to verify: an absent list is refused rather than read as 'nothing is revoked'. An empty list is a statement someone committed; a missing file is an unknown, and an unknown revocation state is not a basis for spending money or publishing. To revoke, add the permitId here and commit. The list is re-read every time authority is EXERCISED, not only when a permit is loaded, so adding an id here also stops work that is already in flight.
_fixtures: wp0-fixture-revoked-0001 is a committed fixture (data/permits/fixtures/). It expired in 2020 and authorises nothing; it is listed here so the revocation path can be proved against the REAL committed list instead of a temp file.
